purpose: Prevent direct unauthenticated CDN retrieval of private export jobs, sources and results; preserve the canonical authenticated Gateway download boundary.
scope: Read current production CDN policy metadata
Create two harmless synthetic canaries under a public and an export prefix; no merchant/customer payloads
If an exact private canary is anonymously readable, append only the reviewed hostname/path Block rule
Verify nonzero public delivery and denial of canonical/encoded private canary paths
Delete the exact two test objects and verify absence
release_scope: This proposal covers only the CDN restriction and controlled canaries. Application deployment, aliases, schema, original files, payment/provider operations and private storage cutover require their own authority.
rollback: If the public control regresses, remove only the newly created rule after deleting the two owned canaries; preserve existing configuration.
limitation: Outer mitigation; complete permanent private storage separation before final production certification.
owner_approval: Approve scoped production privacy check and guard (Recommended)
